description: SPK-01 identifies the JBL Flip 6 reference product in the RhineSound hypothetical supply-chain model.
Main housing material ABS; field name retained for schema compatibility.
Finished speaker mass excluding retail packaging and supplied cable.
Public gross retail reference divided by assumed 1.19 VAT factor for net cost comparison; not verified factory revenue.
Purchased kit identifier CMP-HOUSING through CMP-PACKAGING.
Mass per speaker for the listed purchased kit. All qty_per_unit values are 1.
Default supplier; intentionally empty for non-critical kits. Battery must reference its selected supplier.
Workcenter where the component enters the speaker.
Identical machines or workplaces at the station, one worker each.
Hours the station runs per working day.
Effective scheduled time fraction after downtime; setup consumes effective time separately. Not utilization.
Irregularity of minutes_per_speaker per station, keyed by station name.
Modeled labor plus space/equipment per workplace; no separate electricity purchase charge in course formula, only electricity CO2 charge. Energy bill assumed within overhead allowance.
Hands-on time per speaker at one machine or workplace, without waiting.
Power drawn while working on a speaker.
Power drawn while switched on and waiting.
Discarded incoming wrapping/labels, outside retained BOM; no modeled product scrap or rework.
Direct process water only; building sanitation and upstream water excluded.
SUP-CN and SUP-DE; real candidates with fictional commercial terms.
Scenario contractual target; may be shorter than expected delivery. China target is optimistic and unverified.
Modeled end-to-end lead time in working days; includes production, queue, transport and customs. Not measured history.
Spread (standard deviation) of the delivery time for this supplier (Week 6 view).
Project allocation; planning month is 20 working days (four model weeks), not factory total capacity.
Minimum monthly purchase allocation if this option is active; not automatically a shipment lot or reorder quantity.
Modeled battery production plus inbound transport; do not add network transport again.
Plant, supplier, port, warehouse, dealer region.
Door-to-door elapsed leg time, including stated scheduling allowance; supplier lead time already includes it.
Standard deviation of elapsed leg time; not working days.
MODE-TRUCK, MODE-VAN, MODE-SEA, MODE-RAIL; inherited mode identifiers.
Payload of modeled transport unit; MODE-SEA is a container allocation, not an entire vessel.
Volume of modeled transport unit; shipping package volume is unspecified.
DESNZ Freighting goods direct-operation factors; upstream fuel supply excluded, NOT well-to-wheel. Truck uses articulated >33t at 100% laden.
Electricity: kg CO2 per kWh (direct generation CO2 only); material: kg CO2e per kg.
